results.snippet: VibeVoice-ASR-Streaming is one of the first LLM-based end-to-end approaches to streaming speaker-attributed ASR. By interleaving fixed-size audio chunks, a small amount of lookahead audio, and previous text, it produces “who said what” as speech arrives, with no separate diarization stage.
